notes: Canonical package.json script 'test:e2e:live:p0' exists and targets the four P0 specs including j1.

The script could not be invoked directly on this Windows host because the 'sh -lc' wrapper in package.json caused Windows command-parser errors; execution was performed through an equivalent Node wrapper (.tmp/run-p0-live.mjs) with the same environment and Playwright invocation.

j1-golden-path-backend-integrated.spec.ts has a TypeScript syntax error at line 51 (missing regex delimiter: '//accounts/new...' is parsed as a comment), so the entire spec fails to parse and no j1 tests were executed.

Backend deterministic seed was applied via .tmp/run-seed-with-env.mjs. The running layer4 container initially lacked VALIDATION_SEED_PRIVILEGED_REASON, so the validation seed boundary returned 403; layer4 was recreated with docker-compose.live.yml + docker-compose.live-seed-override.yml setting VALIDATION_SEED_PRIVILEGED_REASON=playwright-backend-validation-seed.

After the env fix, auth-context and business-case lifecycle seed areas reached 'present'; Layer 1 ingestion validation seed endpoint returned 404 via the frontend proxy, and tenant settings seed returned 403 (optional probe).

All 26 executed backend-integrated tests failed. Root cause appears to be frontend auth-provider mismatch: the app now mounts ClerkProvider and RequireClerkAuth, while the E2E helpers seed a legacy validation-session cookie/localStorage. The browser page renders a 'failed to load' error during route guards, causing beforeEach/auth-setup timeouts and workflow validation failures.
The frontend container (vf-live-frontend) is not configured with VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, which also causes main.tsx to throw at module load when Clerk is enabled.
No git commit was made. Temporary files created: .tmp/run-seed-with-env.mjs, .tmp/run-p0-live.mjs, docker-compose.live-seed-override.yml.
